_schema.purpose: DATA CONTRACT for glossary.js inline term popovers.
_schema.shape: Top-level object keyed by term-key (kebab-case, stable id used in [data-term] / .term hooks). Each value is { ru, en } with the localised definition string. i18n.js picks ru or en from <html lang>. Keys prefixed with underscore (like this _schema) are metadata and MUST be skipped by consumers.
rules: term-key is the stable id referenced by diagram-data.js data-term and prose .term triggers
both ru and en are required for every real term
ASCII punctuation only; RU text is the only non-English content allowed in this repo by site-builder; cookbook-author fills final copy

chunk.ru: Fragment dokumenta retrieval-razmera; edinica, kotoruyu embeddyat, hranyat i izvlekayut.
chunk.en: A retrieval-sized fragment of a document; the unit that gets embedded, stored and retrieved.

embedding.ru: Chislovoj vektor, kodiruyushchij smysl teksta tak, chtoby ego mozhno bylo iskat' po blizosti.
embedding.en: A numeric vector that encodes the meaning of text so it can be searched by similarity.

vector.ru: Uporyadochennyj spisok chisel fiksirovannoj dliny (dim); tochka v prostranstve smyslov, vyhod modeli-embeddera.
vector.en: A fixed-length ordered list of numbers (dim); a point in meaning-space, the output of an embedding model.

overlap.ru: Obshchij hvost teksta, povtoryaemyj v konce odnogo chunka i v nachale sleduyushchego, chtoby ne teryat' smysl na granice reza.
overlap.en: A shared tail of text repeated at the end of one chunk and the start of the next so meaning is not lost at the cut boundary.

top-k.ru: K blizhajshih chunkov, vozvrashchaemyh na zapros pered generaciej otveta.
top-k.en: The K nearest chunks returned for a query before the answer is generated.
